definition: The dataset ends on 2025-12-31, which is treated as today. Relative expressions are measured against it: this year is 2025, last year is 2024, the last 90 days are order dates after 2025-10-02 up to and including 2025-12-31, this quarter is Q4 2025 (2025-10-01 to 2025-12-31) and last quarter is Q3 2025 (2025-07-01 to 2025-09-30).
An order whose status is 'completed'. Orders with status 'cancelled' or 'refunded' are not completed orders.
Net revenue in USD: the sum of quantity * unit_price from order_items, counting only orders with status 'completed'. Cancelled and refunded orders are excluded.
The sum of quantity * unit_price from order_items over orders of every status, including cancelled and refunded ones.
Revenue divided by the number of completed orders in the same period, in USD.
A customer with at least one completed order in the last 90 days, that is, an order dated after 2025-10-02 up to and including 2025-12-31 (the reference date).

A customer who was active in the previous 90-day window (a completed order dated after 2025-07-04 up to and including 2025-10-02) and is not active in the current 90-day window (no completed order dated after 2025-10-02 up to 2025-12-31).
A customer with two or more completed orders over the whole dataset.
A customer whose signup_date falls inside the period being analyzed, whether or not they have ordered yet.
The total revenue of one customer over the whole dataset, counting only completed orders.
A customer whose customer lifetime value is at least 1000.00 USD.
The sum of order_items.quantity over completed orders.
Orders with status 'cancelled' divided by all orders, as a percentage rounded to 2 decimals.
Orders with status 'refunded' divided by orders with status 'completed' or 'refunded', as a percentage rounded to 2 decimals.
Support tickets whose status is 'open'. The backlog is counted as of the reference date.
For resolved support tickets, the hours between opened_at and resolved_at. Open tickets have no resolution time.
Rates and shares are reported as percentages between 0 and 100 rounded to 2 decimals, for example 12.34 for twelve point three four percent.
